messages:
sanjay: Heads-up: console ingest started throwing parse errors for some routes during load test. Error looks like: `console-parser: failed to parse X-Redwood-Route header: invalid json` but payload is base64-ish. Anyone changed route header format recently?
tina: That would be TS SDK 2.3.0-beta. We landed a compact-encoding switch behind a flag but CI picked up the flag in the beta build. The header now can be base64(CBOR) instead of plain JSON string.
oliver: Ahhh that's my change. I wanted to reduce per-request bytes for high-qps customers. I thought we kept it opt-in but there was a packaging mixup. Priority is to avoid breaking Console/Runtime.
marie: Product note: if we change header shape it may affect quota/billing dashboards if any pipeline counts header bytes. Need to confirm whether ingestion counts header_size_bytes into request cost. If so, we must show expected delta to customers.
qa: Repro steps: curl with header `X-Redwood-Route: pG...?` (base64 blob) -> console logs `parse_failed`. Also failing e2e: `console-route-heatmap` job. I'll attach snippets in the PR.
sanjay: Short-term plan I propose: 1) runtime accept both encodings (detect: try base64 decode+CBOR, fallback to JSON), 2) revert SDK default to JSON in patch release, 3) ship telemetry to measure adoption of compact encoding, 4) add console tolerant parser + dashboard tile.
tina: I'll prep a 2.3.1 patch to flip the default back to JSON and release ASAP. We'll include config flag `compact_route_headers: true|false` and document it in the changelog.
oliver: I'll open the server PR to add decoder+feature-flag `route_header_compat_mode` (values: both|json_only|compact_only). We'll default to both for 30 days then move to json_only if problems persist.
marie: Banner copy draft: "Route header encoding update: we are rolling out an optional compact header encoding. Console and billing may show reduced header sizes. If you rely on header inspection, upgrade SDKs or enable compat mode in Console settings." Need legal/product review on "billing" phrasing.
qa: For telemetry, suggest events: `route.header.encoding` counter with tag `encoding=json|compact`, and `route.header.size_bytes` histogram. We'll also emit trace tag `route.header.encoding` to correlate failures.
sanjay: Agree. We'll add a Console tile showing per-encoding counts and avg header_size_bytes + a small link to migration docs. Put mock: https://redwood.internal/console/mocks/route-encodings (private).
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: `route-header-compat-v1` -> prod/us-east (canary 3%).
oliver: Also: add backward-compat unit tests matrix in SDK repo: send(json|compact) x receive(json|compact) x console_parse. I'll include them in CI.
tina: ETA for SDK patch: 3 hours. Server decoder + telemetry: I'll coordinate w/ sanjay for rollout. QA will run regen full e2e once canary passes.
marie: Once we have telemetry for 48h, product will decide whether to allow compact by default. Until then, SDK default stays JSON.
sanjay: I'll write migration doc + small snippet for server operators showing how to enable compat flag. Tagging you all on the doc PR. Thanks :thumbsup:
